name: TMP006 non-contact infrared thermopile sensor (I2C)
author: Adafruit
description: Driver for the TI TMP006, an I2C thermopile that measures the infrared energy radiated by whatever faces it and derives that object's temperature without touching it. It also reports its own die temperature, which the object reading is corrected against. Field of view is wide, so it reads an area rather than a spot.

name: TMP007 non-contact infrared thermopile sensor (I2C)
author: Adafruit
description: Driver for the TI TMP007, the successor of the TMP006 and a more accurate I2C thermopile. It reads the infrared energy coming off a surface and turns it into that surface's temperature with no contact, alongside its own die temperature. Adds programmable alert limits and a built-in transient correction the TMP006 lacked.

name: SI1145 UV index / IR / visible light sensor (I2C)
author: Adafruit
description: Driver for the SiLabs SI1145, an I2C light sensor with three outputs at once: a calculated UV index, an infrared level and a visible level. It also holds an LED driver for proximity sensing. Note that it has no true UV photodiode, so the UV index is inferred from the visible and infrared channels.

author: Adafruit

sensore di temperatura di precisione ADT7410
description: Driver for the Analog Devices ADT7410, an I2C thermometer accurate to about 0.5 C over its whole range with no user calibration, and resolvable down to 0.0078 C in 16-bit mode. author: Adafruit
description: Driver for the Maxim DS3502, a 10 kOhm digital potentiometer whose wiper is moved by an I2C command instead of a knob.
